titulo.alumno:
«Доли, проценты и база сравнения»
Shares, percentages and the base of comparison

intro: A percentage always corresponds to a base: participants, households, companies or a period. Identify that base before comparing figures.

piezas.titulo: A percentage always corresponds to a base: participants, households, companies or a period. Identify that base before comparing figures.
texto: A percentage always corresponds to a base: participants, households, companies or a period. Identify that base before comparing figures.
23 процента жителей and growth of 23 per cent do not mean the same thing; an isolated figure does not clarify its reference.

frases.alumno: The share of participants who chose the train rose from 18 to 23 per cent.

frases.estudio: В опросе участвовали 1200 человек, но ответили на этот вопрос только 980.
frases.alumno: 1200 people took part, but only 980 answered this question.
